description.value: Pender Harbour Resort sits on the waterfront of the Sechelt Peninsula (Sunshine Coast), reachable from Vancouver via a 40-minute ferry from Horseshoe Bay followed by a scenic drive through Sechelt to Garden Bay. The property offers a range of accommodation styles — chalet, cabins, motel rooms, and yurts — alongside a 100-slip marina, kayak rentals, and proximity to some of BC's best cold-water scuba diving. An on-site store carries local artisan goods, and the surrounding area provides diverse dining options a short distance away.

address.value: 4686 Sinclair Bay Rd, Garden Bay, BC V0N 1S1
